rules_locked.weekly_highlights: Slide-facing current window begins Sunday after the Friday-night/Saturday build. Include Sunday–Thursday only when genuinely significant; prioritize the following Friday–Sunday evening/night events. Maximum 4–6 rider-facing events. Standalone items must include venue/location.
rules_locked.venue_watch: Keep forward-looking relationship/nightlife venue intelligence in the JSON, including future events beyond the slide window. Under a venue header, do not repeat the venue name. The slide generator must ignore events before week_start when building rider-facing slides.
rules_locked.featured_this_weekend: Focus on the Friday–Sunday weekend following week_start. Favor nightlife, live music, relationship venues, major concerts, Halloween/event friction, and strong ride-demand windows after dark. Maximum 4–6 items.
rules_locked.sports_schedule: Keep forward-looking sports schedules in the JSON. For rider-facing slides, select only games on or after week_start, prioritizing Thunder home games and OU home football.
rules_locked.coming_up: Keep forward-looking high-value future events beyond the primary slide window, especially major concerts, Thunder home games, OU home weekends, Halloween/nightlife, and relationship-venue events.
rules_locked.expired_cleanup: Do not treat Friday/Saturday build-day events as slide-current. Rider-facing slide selection begins at week_start (Sunday). Keep useful future data beyond the slide window.
rules_locked.single_owner: A slide-window event should have one primary slide-section owner to reduce repetition across What's Hot, Featured Weekend, Venue Hotlist, and Metro Sports.
rules_locked.build_cycle: Friday night/Saturday build -> Sunday-forward slides -> primary emphasis on the following Friday/Saturday/Sunday.
rules_locked.crawl_priority: Always prioritize Paycom Center, Riverwind Casino, Grand Casino Resort, and The Criterion. Also track Tower Theatre, Mooney's at Hollywood Corners, The Alley, Chrome Pony, Brickhouse Saloon, One-52, JoJo's, Cowboys OKC, Okie State Room, Beer City Music Hall, Diamond Ballroom, The Jones Assembly, Zoo Amphitheatre, and other meaningful live-music/nightlife venues.
